test_insecure_channel_auth_context: test that an insecure gRPC channel returns None for peer identities and an empty auth context
test_secure_channel_no_client_cert: test that a secure gRPC channel without client cert returns ssl transport type but no peer identity
test_secure_channel_with_client_cert: test mutual TLS by verifying peer identities and x509 common name from a client certificate
test_tls_session_resumption: test that subsequent gRPC secure connections reuse the TLS session via an LRU session cache
review_handle_unary_unary_handler: review the unary unary RPC handler that extracts peer identities, identity key, and auth context from servicer context
